result.summary: Drove the Trickshot Cup Solo flow in the live editor (3 penalty rounds + 1 free-kick round + staged pose tests) with an in-scene capture scheduler, and verified all ten choreographed beats against the design, fixing six real defects on the way: (1) the coin arc used the project's doubled gravity (-19.6) with a fixed 1.4 s flight so the coin apexed at 5.7 m and left the wide shot - now a 9.81 scripted arc apexing at 3.3 m in frame; (2) the arms-round-shoulders lineup pose collapsed because the two draped arms of a 0.62 m pair collide behind the necks (PhysX folded both arms straight up or shoved the pair 0.3-0.6 m apart) - neighbours in a line now ignore each other's colliders and the two arms take different heights (right arm high over the shoulder, left arm low round the back; verified on live pairs, elbow/hand positions measured); (3) the whistle hand dropped in one frame when the 0.9 s emote ended - now a 1.2 s emote with a 0.3 s ease-down after the 0.5 s hold; (4) the walk gait was a sliding high-knee jog at 1.6 m/s (cadence scaled by amount, +0.25 offset) - one shared walk gait with walk-scale lift/knee and a speed-appropriate cadence, referee included; (5) the AI taker's walk-in to a left-side free-kick spot went straight through the referee's mark and shoved him 1.3 m - walks now detour 1.3 m round the referee (measured min distance 1.24 m, referee unmoved); (6) the penalty cam sat 1 m behind the taker so his head filled the right third of the frame as a flesh blob - stand-off raised to 3.5 m behind the run-up mark (whole body in frame). Also silenced the per-bone 'Setting linear velocity of a kinematic body' errors (SnapBone on parked twins / PlayerPreview). Editor left stopped, compiled, console error-free; graph updated.

beatsVerified: 1 Coin toss ceremony: referee walks from his mark to 2 m short of the spot at 1.6 m/s, captain jogs to x=-1.2 facing him, overlay up from frame 1, 5 s timeout -> HEADS, flick, 1.4 s arc (apex 3.3 m after the gravity fix, was 5.7 m), lands 1.0 m in front (z=5.0 for a spot at 6), one bounce, settles flat face-up on the seeded face (TAILS = ring up), HEADS/TAILS flash + 'X KICK FIRST'; all bodies, ball and landing spot in the 6 m / 1.6 m / FOV 55 wide shot

2 Whistle raise: right hand reaches the mouth at 0.37-0.45 s of WhistleRaise (hand 0.06 m above head centre, 0.25 m in front, centred), whistle audio fires at Armed entry (0.4 s), hold 0.5 s, then a 0.3 s ease-down (was a one-frame snap); referee stands 3 m to the taker's right level with the ball facing him, ball ignores him

3 Placement: taker at run-up start 3 m behind the spot facing the goal, keeper on the line (z=16.06), lineups at z=-0.5 (box edge +1 m) at x=+-5.69/6.31 (0.62 m spacing), referee at spot+3 m right; lone lineup body hands on hips (LoneWatch); two-body line now drapes one arm over the neighbour's shoulder and the other round his back, pair fixed at 0.66-0.69 m and swaying (after the collision-ignore + high/low fix; the original pose put both arms straight up with hands meeting above the heads)

4 AI taker walk: from the +6 lineup mark to the run-up start at 2.16 m/s (penalty, 3 s) or a jog up to 4.6 m/s for far free-kick spots (18 m in 4 s), planted exactly on the mark, takes the real charge/run-up/strike, walks back; now detours round the referee instead of shoving him

5 Scored window: human scorer Freed for 5.0 s with CLICK TO SKIP (CanLocalSkip true), Celebration.Play(Cheer) from code plays on the freed body (12b-scorer-emote.png), camera HoldOn; AI scorer runs 1.2 s toward his lineup at ~4 m/s then plays seeded emotes (HandsUp, Cheer, FistPump); window closes at 5.0 s into the goal replay then Placing

6 Walk-back: shooter turns and walks at exactly 1.60 m/s toward his lineup mark, rig low shot beside the goal for 1.5 s then a cut to the wide shot behind the lineup; arrival seen for near free-kick spots (5.2 m in 3.4 s), snap after 3.5 s hidden by the replay or placement cut for the 8.6 m penalty walk

7 Dejection trio: DejectHips seen on the losing human keeper (goal against) and human shooter (losing miss) in real rounds; DejectKnees (pelvis 0.98->0.52, both hands on the face) and DejectFall (arms to the head, balance dropped at 0.8 s, falls straight onto its back: pelvis 0.98->0.16, hands 0.07 m either side behind the head, stays down) verified on staged bodies; AI keeper fell in-round too (pelvis 0.98->0.15); losing lineup dejects; beat 4 s

8 Win beat: on the human's winning kick the human body is Freed for 5.0 s (CLICK TO SKIP, BRAZIL WIN banner) while the AI shooter (DejectHips) and AI keeper (DejectFall, on the ground in the goal) deject; when the AI wins its bodies cycle Wave2/FistPump/Clap/HandsUp/MuscleFlex staggered

9 Two-body swap: at every kick the parked twin sits at the hide spot (-4.5, 0, 26) behind the goal with 0 renderers enabled (checked each Armed phase, both twins), swap happens inside the placement cut; never seen in any frame

10 Free kicks: 4-man wall built 9.15 m from the spot on the ball-goal line, hops on the strike (blocker y 0.93->1.62->0.93 over 0.6 s, HopHeight 0.7) on every kick, AI shooter walks/jogs from the lineup to the free-kick run-up start, referee mark follows the spot, Follow cam shows taker/wall/goal
result.notesForNextAgents: HOW TO DRIVE A ROUND IN THE EDITOR: CupDebugCapture (Assets/Scripts/Cup/CupDebugCapture.cs, editor-only) is the verification harness - from execute_code: c=CupDebugCapture.Instance; c.OnRoundPhase(phase, delay, path) / c.BurstOnRoundPhase / c.When(Func<bool>, delay, path) schedule screenshots that fire mid-motion; c.AddProbe(name, interval, Func<string>) logs sampled values on change; c.Dump() returns the timeline (every director/driver phase change + toss stage + probes). Trigger lambdas may have side effects (that is how I auto-kicked and forced verdicts). A probe that disables director/Rig/GameCam/Hud, places the Camera and calls ScreenCapture, then re-enables on its next tick, gives clean close-ups. CupRoundDriver.DebugAutoKick() takes the human's kick with the bot; DebugForceVerdict(outcome) resolves Armed/Live with a chosen outcome (steer a round into any branch). CupChoreo.DebugWalk / DebugAvoidPoint stage walks on loose bodies (CupBodies.BuildAi + a hand-made CupBody + CupChoreo.Create(root,null,null) works in the NationPick phase: the arena is standing, no round needed). The MCP round trip is seconds, but MY reading/thinking between calls let 30-150 s of game time pass - schedule captures ahead, never poll for a moment. WARNING: when the editor window has focus, ANY file write (yours or a parallel agent's) auto-refreshes and domain-reloads IN PLAY MODE; non-serialized fields (every ActiveRagdoll's _rb bone array) come back null and the session is dead - keep sessions short and never edit files while playing. JOINT SIGN CONVENTION (measured on a live body facing +Z, pelvis-relative): CupPoses' derived rule is CORRECT - UpperArmL Z=-100 puts the elbow (-0.25, +0.05, 0) out-left, Y=-40 sweeps it BACK to z=-0.21, ForearmL Z=+55 folds the hand DOWN (-0.33) - so any 'mirrored' pose report is a collision problem, not a sign problem. The lineup failure was mutual collision: two 0.62 m neighbours' draped arms occupy the same space behind the necks; CupChoreo now ignores collider pairs between adjacent lineup bodies (IgnoreNeighbourCollisions, lifted in Release/OnPlacing/OnDestroy) and CupPoses alternates HIGH (right arm, Z 120 / Y 55 / fold 70) and LOW (left arm, Z 80 / Y 40 / fold 40). Project gravity is -19.6 (SimConfig.Gravity): any scripted arc must use its own g (CupCoinToss.ArcGravity 9.81). CupPoses.WalkGait is now the single gait for every cup walk (referee too): GaitAmount = speed / SetPieceRunupSpeed (0.29 at a walk), cadence StrideRateMax * Lerp(0.6, 1, amount). CupPenaltyCam.MinBehindTaker is 3.5 (camera 6.5 m behind the ball). Celebration.WhistleRaise is 1.2 s: reaches the mouth at p 0.375 (0.45 s), holds, eases down over the last 0.3 s. ActiveRagdoll.SnapBone no longer writes velocities on kinematic bodies (the 'Setting linear velocity of a kinematic body' console errors from parked twins and PlayerPreview are gone). Solo-only facts seen: the human's entrant can be side A or B (kick parity != human); the round's bodies die at RoundPhase.Over in the same frame (an Over-triggered capture never fires); in Solo a lineup never has two bodies, so arms-round-shoulders only shows in Co-op/H2H.
openIssues: Penalty walk-back never arrives: spot -> lineup mark is 8.6 m = 5.4 s at CupTuning.WalkSpeed 1.6 vs WalkBackMax 3.5 s, so the 'wide shot as they arrive' never shows an arrival in Penalties (it does for near free-kick spots, e.g. 5.2 m in 3.4 s). The snap is hidden by the replay (after a save) or the placement cut (after a miss) exactly as the design allows; raise WalkSpeed or move LineupX (6) in if the arrival should be seen.

CupTuning.ScoredCutSeconds (0.3) is defined but unused: the scored window and the win beat close with an immediate cut to the replay / next placement (CloseWindowAndContinue). No 0.3 s cut/fade exists.

The AI scorer's 5 s window is watched from the local keeper's camera position (CupCameraRig.HoldOn keeps the KeeperFollow position and only turns): the AI scorer runs ~20 m toward his lineup and his run + emotes are a tiny figure. A cut to a tracking shot on the AI scorer would read better (design 7.4 only says 'the camera stays on them').

After a goal/save replay, the next placement for a local KEEPER eases the camera from the broadcast vantage (e.g. (31,17,-16)) to behind the keeper over ~1 s (GameCamera.KeeperFollow SmoothDamp); the Penalty and Lineup views cut. Cosmetic swoop across the pitch.

Intro card: the driver's Intro entry snaps everyone from the ceremony to their marks while the camera stays at the coin-toss position, so under the card the referee pops from the spot to his mark 4 m from the lens at the frame edge (07-intro.png). Under a card, but visible.

Penalty cam framing (C2's documented tension, unchanged): with the ball-visibility rule the posts land near 35/65 percent of the frame width, not the designed 11/89. With MinBehindTaker 3.5 the taker is now fully in frame off to the right instead of a head blob (08-armed-penaltycam.png).

Free-kick lineup vs wall (F's note, not observed in my spots): for spots near x=+-6 and 25+ m out the 4-man wall (9.15 m toward the goal) can stand within ~1 m of the +6 lineup at z~-1.5; lineup marks are format-agnostic (CupSpots.LineupMark).

Referee's coin-toss arm (CupCoinToss.LateUpdate pose) reads as an arm pointed out to his right-front rather than an open palm in front of the chest; the coin still leaves the hand point correctly. Minor.
DejectHips' 35-degree head-down is hard to read on the featureless head sphere in close-ups (hands on hips reads fine); DejectKnees/DejectFall read clearly.

Not covered by this pass: Co-op / Head-to-Head (Solo only; a real two-body lineup was staged by hand through EnterLineup), the human WIN-beat emote (same freed-body + Celebration.Play mechanism verified in the scored window), the podium (does not exist yet). The seeded dejection variant for the protagonist came out as DejectHips in both real losses; Knees and Fall were verified on staged bodies and the Fall on the AI keeper in-round.

Environment: with the editor focused, parallel agents' file writes trigger domain reloads in play mode (nulls every ragdoll's bone arrays); one session was lost to this. A stray compile error from another agent's in-flight CupLobbyUI.cs edit (missing CupText.Results) appeared mid-session and resolved on its own.
